More detail

+0 to +30: each + adds 5% health and attack through +10, then 2% each. Kings and Mythics receive double this bonus. No fresh-mix bonus is included.

How fights work: a hit does the attacker's attack minus half the target's defence. If that leaves almost nothing, the hit does 0 or 1, so a mob far stronger than yours can't be worn down. Evade is the chance to dodge a hit or take only half of it, and a quick attacker with a high evade of its own gets dodged less. Stats grow at the same pace all the way to Lv.40. All rows use the selected level, with the selected + bonus, no fresh-mix bonus, inherited stats or spent perks. Natural traits are included. Power is health × attack. Click a column heading to sort; click again to reverse.

Tap an underlined mob name to jump to its row. Tap a name in the Mob column to search for it: that shows the mob plus every mob it helps make or is made from.

Kind

The town's shops and helpers: what each one buys, sells or does, and for how many coins. Search an item to see every place that buys or sells it.

Your wallet

Holds up to 999 coins. With a full wallet the Shop won't buy from you, and coins from bounties past 999 are lost, so spend some first. Collect quests once you have room.

Earning coins

Sell finds at the Shop or the Fisherman. Finish Quest Master quests (6-25 coins). Beat Bounty Board bosses (10-25). Plain wild mobs drop trade goods to sell.

Daily deals

Every day one trade good pays double at the Shop, one Shop item is 20% off, and the Fisherman pays double for one fish.
